intent: Use established GUID types for the two complete native session identifier copies without changing failure behavior or any other session logic.
evidence: Pinned 62EB7C..62EB99 copies the borrowed GUID pointer established by Net::init into DPSESSIONDESC2::guidApplication. Native dereferences without a null guard; do not add one.

Pinned 62ECD7..62ECEE copies the successfully populated heap descriptor's guidInstance into the inline NetAllocationNode GUID at Net+70C..718, before flags/count stores and free. Source and destination objects are distinct under the existing allocation contract.

Both source and destination GUID types already exist in net_class.h and SDK descriptors; Net::enumerate_sessions already assigns guidApplication directly. Remove word-punning only, preserving statement locations and all original error/leak/uninitialized paths. Validate actual source controls, whole-owner native baseline comparison, unchanged mappings/claims/references and application build/link. No new coverage or acceptance claim.
